limitations: Two known rigid surfaces, seven known starts per surface, four placement repetitions; no unseen surfaces or perturbations.
Two independent training seeds per surface reuse all evaluation conditions.
Reference-assisted residual PPO; repaired reference success is not evidence that PPO learned the transition.
Torque proxies are not electrical energy or proof of a global optimum.
Effort comparisons use common full-duration support successes only.
Reference and fixed posture appended reference features differ; physical state and sensor histories must match exactly.
Slew validation uses10Hz exported traces and frozen50Hz controller bounds.
